title: Changed Creator latex form definition
description: Defines a custom transfur variant (latex form) for Changed: Minecraft Mod v0.15.7. Drop this JSON into <minecraft>/config/changedcreator/forms/ and restart the game.

id.description: Variant id. The full id becomes changedcreator:<id>, usable with /tf @s changedcreator:<id>

base_entity.description: ResourceLocation of an existing Changed latex entity to reuse (model/texture/renderer), e.g. changed:dark_latex_wolf_male

transfur_mode.description: How this form transfurs other entities

abilities.description: Ability ids to grant, e.g. changed:toggle_night_vision

properties.description: Gameplay properties of the variant (Changed v0.15.7 API). Note: faction/stepSize/jumpStrength are entity-level and inherited from base_entity. Keys use snake_case; camelCase variants are also accepted.

glide.description: Has wings: nerfed creative fly + elytra-style fall flying

disable_items.description: Cannot use items, break blocks, or attack

hold_items_in_mouth.description: Can hold one item out, cannot break blocks

camera_z_offset.description: Camera offset from center in blocks
